presentation.speaker: jun_ito
presentation.title: Manufacturer recall
lines: A maker has recalled a part used in some of your rental cars. Pull them from service for three days, or keep renting them and risk breakdowns.

choices.label: Pull the cars for repair
choices.outcome: Handling costs $120 per car and they are off the road for three days.

choices.label: Keep renting them
choices.outcome: No lost rentals, but each car may break down over the next three weeks.
